about: Round RPG4: the region and its towns. PLACEHOLDERS: the names, colours and set lists are Claude's, for the game logic to run on; Karl names them when the region's content is written. A town's shop sells singles from its region's tier band (tiers, inclusive) leaning to its colours, and booster packs of its sets (only sets with a pack pool in rpg/data/packs/). An enemy's reward cards come from the same band.
